channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: RBI leaves repo rate unchanged, sticks to neutral policy stance
item.description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra noted that while global uncertainties have intensified since the last policy review, recent trade deals signed by the government provide support to India's growth prospects.

item.title: Indian Army renames 246 roads, buildings to shed colonial legacy
item.description: The renamed locations include roads, residential colonies, buildings, and training facilities, with new names honouring gallantry award winners, war heroes, freedom fighters, and distinguished military leaders.

item.title: With Love movie review: A simple, feel-good entertainer
item.description: Director Madan's Tamil movie With Love starring Abhishan Jeevinth, Anaswara Rajan and Harish Kumar has received positive reviews and ratings from the audience, who describe it as a simple feel-good entertainer.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary defends stablecoins to boost dollar power
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has defended proposed legislation regulating stablecoins, arguing that dollar-backed digital assets could strengthen the global dominance of the US dollar and create new sources of funding for the US government.

item.title: Trump launches TrumpRx.gov to slash drug prices; here's how it works
item.description: The platform allows consumers to access steep discounts on commonly used prescription drugs through downloadable or printable coupons redeemable at participating pharmacies.

item.title: No need to demand Article 370 restoration, it still exists in Indian Constitution: Omar Abdullah
item.description: Omar Abdullah said there was no need to demand the restoration of Article 370 as the provision continues to exist in the Constitution, though in a "hollowed-out" form. Winding up the debate on the Vote of Thanks to the Lieutenant Governor's address, he reaffirmed that restoring Jammu and Kashmir's special status and statehood remains the top priority of the National Conference-led government.

item.title: RBI raises FY27 Q1, Q2 growth forecast on GST reforms, strong domestic demand
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has revised upward its real GDP growth projections for the first two quarters of 2026–27, with growth now expected at 6.9 per cent in Q1 and 7.0 per cent in Q2, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said on Friday.

item.title: RCB honour captain Smriti Mandhana rejoices second WPL triumph; Virat Kohli writes 'keeping the RCB flag flying high'
item.description: Smriti Mandhana led RCB sealed a six-wicket win over Delhi Capitals to lift the WPL 2026 trophy. RCB chased down a massive 204 runs with six wickets and two balls to spare, completing the highest successful chase in WPL history.Virat Kohli, Anushka Sharma and fans rejoiced as RCB clinched yet another memorable win.

item.title: SEBI proposes to extend standing SWP, STP instructions to demat-held mutual funds
item.description: The regulator has suggested a two-phase rollout. The first phase would enable unit-based SWP and STP mandates executed through stock exchange platforms, while the second phase would shift processing to registrars and transfer agents and introduce more flexible options such as amount-based, appreciation-based withdrawals and swing STPs.

item.title: Luxury bus catches fire after hitting electric pole on NH-48 near Bengaluru; passengers escape unhurt
item.description: A luxury bus caught fire after hitting a road divider and an electric pole near the Hanumanthapura–Kerekathiganur gate in Nelamangala taluk of Bangalore Rural district in the early hours of Friday.
